pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with fuzzy, non-linear edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are larger and more stellate, while those on the posterior and lower flank are smaller and more sub-circular in geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: An interconnected network of light-colored interstitial pathways with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the central flank, showing slight narrowing at junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck ridge, characterized by dense, short vertical hair projections that create a fuzzy 1D boundary against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Small, localized punctate dark spots and textural irregularities are visible along the upper flank and dorsal ridge, potentially indicating parasitic attachment sites.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge near the transition from the upper neck to the shoulder.
